changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO public.custom_field (custom_field_id, answer_type, label, is_system_field, value_binding, field_code) SELECT v.id, 'SELECT_MULTIPLE_STRATIGRAPHY', v.label, true, v.binding, v.code FROM (VALUES (-328, 'recordingunit.field.anteriorRelationships', 'anteriorRelationships', 'SIARU.STRATI.ANTERIOR'), (-329, 'recordingunit.field.posteriorRelationships', 'posteriorRelationships', 'SIARU.STRATI.POSTERIOR'), (-330, 'recordingunit.field.synchronousRelationships', 'synchronousRelationships', 'SIARU.STRATI.SYNCHRONOUS')) AS v(id, label, binding, code) WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.custom_field f WHERE f.custom_field_id = v.id);

changeSet.sql: DO $do$ DECLARE v_rule bigint := (SELECT r.relation_rule_id FROM public.relation_rule r JOIN public.relation_definition d ON d.relation_definition_id = r.fk_relation_definition_id WHERE d.fk_source_field_id = -328 AND r.fk_institution_id IS NULL); v_count integer; BEGIN WITH concepts AS (SELECT * FROM public.tmp_siamois_strati_concepts()), candidates AS ( SELECT DISTINCT q.concept_id AS concept, m.concept_id AS mirror FROM public.tmp_siamois_strati_pairs() p JOIN concepts q ON q.label = p.posterior_label JOIN concepts m ON m.label = p.anterior_label AND m.vocabulary_id = q.vocabulary_id AND m.grp = q.grp WHERE (q.grp = 'order' AND q.branch = 'SIARU.STRATI.ANTERIOR' AND m.branch = 'SIARU.STRATI.POSTERIOR') OR (q.grp = 'legacy') ), one_to_one AS ( SELECT c.concept, c.mirror FROM candidates c WHERE (SELECT count(*) FROM candidates x WHERE x.concept = c.concept) = 1 AND (SELECT count(*) FROM candidates x WHERE x.mirror = c.mirror) = 1 ) INSERT INTO public.relation_rule_mirror_concept (fk_relation_rule_id, fk_concept_id, fk_mirror_concept_id) SELECT v_rule, o.concept, o.mirror FROM one_to_one o WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.relation_rule_mirror_concept e WHERE e.fk_relation_rule_id = v_rule AND (e.fk_concept_id = o.concept OR e.fk_mirror_concept_id = o.mirror)); GET DIAGNOSTICS v_count = ROW_COUNT; RAISE NOTICE 'Stratigraphy: % mirror pairs declared', v_count; END $do$;
